title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia
description: After losing her mother and her homeland, Sitara’s despair transforms into determination with the power of knowledge. New possibilities unfold when a family of scholars takes her in, deepening her education. Meanwhile, Genghis Khan’s Mongol Empire conquers nation after nation, nearing Sitara’s new home. After the Fourth Prince of the empire takes her captive, a flame of revenge is ignited.

episodes_data.title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Sitara, a young slave girl, is sold to a family of scholars, where she begins her journey of knowledge.

episodes_data.title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: As nomads sack the city of Tun, Fatima and Sitara hide in the basement and wait for the others to return.

episodes_data.title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Sitara teams up with an unexpected ally in hopes of reclaiming Fatima's book that was stolen by the Mongols.

episodes_data.title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Sitara begins tutoring Sorghaghtani in Euclid's Elements, and learns more about Prince Tolui, the Otchigin.

episodes_data.title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Sitara agrees to serve as Sorghaghtani's spy, but her plans to infiltrate Chagatai's court quickly go awry.

episodes_data.title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Töregene tells the tale of her life among the Merkits, a confederation of tribes renowned for their archery.

episodes_data.title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: As the Mongol Empire prepares to wage war to the east, Sitara begins to plant the seeds of political intrigue.
